title: We all move at the Speed of Light
summary: ScienceClic explains why nothing can go faster than light by treating motion through space and time together, so everything moves at the speed of light through spacetime. It uses animated visuals to cover relativity basics in 12 minutes.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a helpful way to conceptualize why light speed is a limit.

quote.text: I know a lot of people find this video helpful in conceptualizing things.
